acceptance.every_regime: zero candidate envelope violations; active steps nondecreasing; external commands, prediction error and goal error nonincreasing

protocol.cost: Observed episode wall time and actual enumerated longer-horizon sequences; no timing acceptance threshold or speedup claim
protocol.holdout: Once after validation passes; selected candidate and identical controls
protocol.selection: Train only; unchanged recovery gates against frozen_h1, matched frozen horizon and matched adaptive consistent horizon; highest summed goal gain against frozen_h1, then lexical arm name
protocol.validation: Selected candidate and unique frozen and adaptive controls only; no second candidate after failure
